crossRefs.note: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess…
So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful…
Abigail hurried, and arose, and rode on a donkey, with five ladies of hers who followed her; and she went after the…
Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your…
The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house…
After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.
Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David…
Absalom happened to meet David’s servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of…
The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate, and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son…
But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.
So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

people.name: Abigail
people.line: Wife of Nabal, later married David

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Carmel
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail

people.name: Chileab
people.line: Son of David and Abigail the Carmelitess

people.name: Geshur
people.line: Aramean kingdom; Talmai's domain; refuge for Absalom

people.name: Maacah
people.line: Daughter of Talmai; wife of David; mother of Absalom

people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

people.name: Talmai
people.line: King of Geshur; father of David's wife Maacah
